summary: LEGION-107 corrective round 1 on PR #1120: REQUEST_CHANGES (pullrequestreview-5206722769, legion-reviewer[bot]) at PR tip b691420860ff9a8de74b6b057a9211d3b860660d (code head 53ec38796351c886797e28748633b606cda530ab, identical tree to 98dec8e6). One Blocking finding, reproduced at the head: resendToRootArchitect now calls resendLedger.claim() before the pre-pause liveness probe, and a probe that throws (tmux list-panes failing without proving the pane gone — 'server not responding', processes.test.ts:4595's fixture) propagates to handleException's catch with the entry left inFlight and no settle(); every later failure of that message inside RESEND_LEDGER_TTL_MS is answered in-flight, refreshes touchedAt, and is dropped — the message is never re-sent while it keeps failing, and the line says 'pending' when nothing is. Fix: settle on the throw path as the dead branch does (try/catch around the probe), plus a regression lock. Second requirement: the PR body carries no E2E (tester) line and no tester comment/review exists on #1120 — the tester's evidence is only in .legion/test.json (d8c155d7, unpushed, deleted with .legion/), so the tester must add the line to the body on re-test (legion gh -- pr edit; no CI). Everything else is clean: keep-at-cap, justCapped once per chain, TTL refresh on capped claims (module comment states it), capped entries can never be inFlight or touch resendWaits, dispose() unchanged, tests assert console.error count / clock.pending / list-panes count, AGENTS.md restoration matches main's code and states the new rule, scope confined to the five daemon files, contract 5 and state schema untouched; claim-before-probe accepted on the merits once the throw path settles. CI green at the tip (Tests run 34938724233), MERGEABLE, 0 prior threads.

keyFindings.description: Pre-pause probe throw after claim() leaves the ledger entry inFlight with no settle(); later failures of the same message are dropped as in-flight with the TTL refreshed each time, so the message is never re-sent while it keeps failing. Reproduced at head. Fix: settle in a catch around the probe and rethrow; add a regression lock (second exception after a throwing probe is judged resend).
E2E (tester) line missing from the PR body; no tester comment or review on #1120. Tester adds it on re-test via legion gh -- pr edit 1120 --body-file (no CI).
Restored parenthetical 'LEGION_DAEMON_API_VERSION stays 2' is stale — main is 5 on both sides; say 'no bump'. Fast-follow.
Cap line 'ignored for 5 minutes' understates a rolling window ('until 5 quiet minutes pass'); the resendToRootArchitect doc should say a dead-root exception consumes an attempt. Fast-follow.
'the only removal' overlooks clear() from dispose(). Fast-follow.

judgements.1_claimBeforeProbe: Accepted on the merits with the throw-path settle: spec v7 forbids a probe on a capped claim; non-capped exceptions still probe before the pause (dead -> settle + resurrect); in-flight's dead root is caught by the post-pause probe within <=45 s; capped-only traffic on a dead root is the resync backstop's. Observation: a dead-root exception consumes an attempt (conservative, bounded).
judgements.2_ttlRefresh: Confirmed: touchedAt = now precedes the capped branch; module comment states the rolling-silence consequence; dispose(), settle(), resendWaits do not depend on drop-at-cap.
judgements.3_capOnce: Proven from claim(): capped reachable only when !inFlight and returns before inFlight = true; justCapped true exactly once until the TTL prune deletes the entry.
judgements.4_tests: New processes test asserts clock.pending, publications, controlRequests, console.error call count, and list-panes count; rewritten P14 control asserts clock.pending and error count; ledger tests pin T0+TTL capped and T0+2*TTL+1 fresh, and the rolling refresh.
judgements.5_agentsMd: Restoration verified as restoration (main had the pre-#1085 bullet); every restored sentence matches main's code; new rule stated once; one stale 'stays 2' parenthetical (minor).
judgements.6_scope: Only packages/daemon/src/daemon/{AGENTS.md,processes.ts,resend-ledger.ts} and the two tests; worker-admission/events/index untouched; nothing under packages/envoy, packages/pi-envoy, skills/, packages/contracts, legion-state.ts, .omp/.
